home.h1: Maintenance and repair of lifting, aerial platform and material handling equipment in the South of France
home.subtitle: JEKKO, SOCAGE and CORMACH maintenance agent. On-site service or in our Carros workshop, across the Alpes-Maritimes, Var, Bouches-du-Rhône and Alpes-de-Haute-Provence.
home.heroAlt: Spider crane and platform working on a job site overlooking Marseille
home.aboutTitle: On site or in the workshop, we travel to you
about: With 3 technicians and 3 fully equipped workshop vans, we work wherever the machine is located: hilltop village, city-centre job site or remote location. Distance and access are not obstacles.

Every job is carried out with the same standards and professional rigour, from a minor repair to a complete refurbishment. Our priority: the machine must be safe for those who will use it after we leave.
Our technicians are trained directly at our partner manufacturers. We stay up to date with French VGP regulations and take care of your periodic inspections and returns to service.

vgp.title: Periodic inspections (VGP) and returns to service: handled by us
vgp.text: We take charge of your periodic inspections (VGP) and returns to service. We schedule the inspection with BUREAU VERITAS, prepare the machine beforehand and promptly resolve any reservation raised during the inspection. A single point of contact, a compliant machine, a report signed by a recognised body: the best guarantee for you and your operators. Between two inspections, we remain available in the event of an incident.

lifting.h1: Lifting: JEKKO and CORMACH repair in the South of France
lifting.heroAlt: JEKKO tracked mini crane with outriggers deployed in front of an industrial building
lifting.lead: Mini crawler crane, truck-mounted loader crane or crane arm: we service, repair and refurbish all lifting equipment, on site with our workshop vans or in our Carros workshop. Hydraulics, electrics, combustion and electric engines, welding: we work on the machine as a whole.

sections.h2: JEKKO repair and maintenance in PACA: mini cranes
paras: Italian manufacturer specialised in mini crawler cranes, JEKKO covers the whole range: from the small SPB209 (990 kg) to the JF series articulated crawler cranes such as the JF545 (15.5 t). In between, the SPX telescopic mini cranes (SPX312, SPX424, SPX429, SPX527, SPX532, SPX1040, SPX1275) are the reference for lifting indoors, in city centres and any location with restricted access.
DANTÈS is a JEKKO maintenance agent. Our technicians were trained at the manufacturer and we work on the whole range, from routine servicing to full refurbishment.
sections.alt: JEKKO mini crane lifting on a job site in Monaco, JEKKO maintenance Alpes-Maritimes

sections.h2: CORMACH repair in PACA: loader cranes and crane arms
paras: Italian manufacturer of truck-mounted loader cranes, CORMACH makes cranes of all sizes, from compact models for light trucks up to 80 t capacity cranes in the 575000 series. We work the brand with Carrosserie CORNUT, which brings its experience of CORMACH-equipped trucks. DANTÈS is a CORMACH maintenance agent and our technicians were trained there.
sections.alt: CORMACH loader crane mounted on a truck, CORMACH loader crane maintenance

sections.h2: Truck-mounted crane repair in the Alpes-Maritimes: FASSI, PALFINGER, HIAB and all makes
paras: Beyond our partner brands, we repair and service truck-mounted cranes and loader cranes of all makes: FASSI, PALFINGER, HIAB and others. Hydraulics, electrics, outriggers, load limiter: our technicians work on site anywhere in PACA or in our Carros workshop, to the same standards as on JEKKO and CORMACH.
sections.alt: JEKKO SPX1275 mini crane stabilised at the workshop site, with the DANTÈS van behind

sections.h2: Buy a used JEKKO in France: new and second-hand
paras: We handle sales of JEKKO mini cranes and CORMACH cranes, new or used. Available machines are posted in our news section.

elevation.h1: Aerial platforms: SOCAGE and CELA repair in the South of France
elevation.heroAlt: Row of truck-mounted platforms with their booms raised under a clear sky
elevation.lead: Truck-mounted platform, spider lift or telescopic platform: we service, repair and refurbish your work-at-height machines, on site or in the workshop. Our technicians are trained directly at the manufacturers, to work quickly and accurately on machines that carry people.

sections.h2: SOCAGE repair in PACA: truck-mounted platforms and spider lifts
paras: Based near Modena in Italy, SOCAGE has built truck-mounted platforms for over 40 years and sells them worldwide. The range is very extensive: platforms on vans and 3.5 t chassis for the city, platforms on trucks up to the very high reach of the Forste series, and tracked spider lifts.
DANTÈS is a SOCAGE maintenance agent and our technicians were trained at the manufacturer in Italy. We work on the whole range: hydraulics, on-board electronics, stabilisation, basket.
sections.alt: SOCAGE Forste 27D truck-mounted platform deployed, SOCAGE platform maintenance

sections.h2: CELA platform repair: DT trucks, Spyder spider lifts, rescue platforms
paras: Founded in 1965 near Brescia, CELA designs highly specialised platforms: DT range truck-mounted platforms (25 to 60 m), able to work below ground level, with a removable basket that can be replaced by a winch, and Spyder tracked spider lifts. The brand also equips fire services with its rescue platforms.
Our technicians were trained at CELA on these specific machines, which allows us to work where few repairers are qualified.
sections.alt: CELA DT30 Spyder spider lift used by firefighters

sections.h2: Platform maintenance, all makes: truck-mounted, telescopic, articulated and scissor lifts
paras: Beyond SOCAGE and CELA, we work on all types of platforms and all makes: MULTITEL truck-mounted platforms, HAULOTTE, JLG, SKYJACK and others. Telescopic, articulated, scissor, spider or truck-mounted, recent or older machine: we return it to service, on site anywhere in PACA or in our Carros workshop.
sections.alt: JLG spider lift being repaired on site, DANTÈS workshop van behind

paras: Telecom operators and their subcontractors work at height, often on hard-to-reach sites, with platforms that cannot stay out of service. We maintain and repair these machines on site: hydraulics, electrics, stabilisation, basket. Our objective: a safe platform, available whenever the crew needs it.

sections.h2: Film and TV shoot platforms: repair and maintenance
paras: On a shoot, a machine breakdown halts an entire crew. We service and repair the platforms used by film and audiovisual production companies, checking safety components before the shoot, with a rapid response if a fault appears during the day.

sections.h2: SOCAGE and CELA platforms for sale: new and used
paras: SOCAGE and CELA platforms, new or used: we advise you on the machine suited to your use. Available machines are posted in our news section.

elevation.ctaText: Call us: fast on-site service in 06, 83, 13 and 04.

handling.h1: Material handling: forklift repair, all makes
handling.heroAlt: Truck-mounted crane lifting a telehandler during a material handling operation
handling.lead: Forklift, stacker, electric pallet truck or more specific machine: we repair and service material handling equipment of all makes. Engine, hydraulic, electrical, mast or brake faults: we adapt to each machine and situation, on site or in our Carros workshop.

sections.h2: Forklift breakdown service in Nice and across PACA
paras: Combustion or electric, recent or old: our workshop vans come to the machine, from Nice to Marseille. If it has to come to the workshop, our 5 t vehicle lift in Carros lets us handle it.
sections.alt: DANTÈS workshop van working on a site, on-site breakdown service
